Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A physics teacher and a cashier were talking about how they ended up in the jobs they did. The physics teacher recalled having a hard time before college, even not passing some classes, and the cashier started their story talking about having been a member of the honors society back in high school. Who failed classes in high school?
A. Not enough information
B. The physics teacher
C. The cashier
